what: EXPLORATORY arm 6, added after the one test run: an equal-weight ensemble of ideas used by models above ESM-2 on ProteinGym. Version and cutoff chosen on the start region only. Nothing here changes outputs/frozen.json.
selection_rule: highest start-region AUROC (LOF vs FUNC, 516 rows); a tie goes to the simpler version
chosen_name: the ESM-2 and ESM-C scores plus AlphaFold burial and BLOSUM62, equally weighted
cutoff_rule: highest cutoff catching at least 90% of start-region harmful rows
